aboutBody: Bloxbert ni laboratoire yo kubaka ya Tech Room muri Solvay. Moteri ya 3D ni noa (MIT) na Babylon.js (Apache-2.0). Ibishushanyo bya block ni Kenney Voxel Pack (CC0).
autoHint: Ni yo myiza ku benshi. Igabanya ibisobanuro niba itinda.
creditEngine: Moteri: noa (MIT) + Babylon.js (Apache-2.0). Ibishushanyo: Kenney Voxel Pack (CC0).
fsIphone: Ku ekarani yuzuye kuri iPhone: kanda Sangiza, hanyuma Ongeraho ku rupapuro rw’urugo.
fullHint: Iragaragara neza, ureba kure. Ikeneye igikoresho cyihuta.
keysHint: WASD kugenda. Shift kwiruka. Z kwicaramye. Umwanya usimbuka igice kimwe. Fata ibumoso uvunagure. Iburyo gushyira. Q ikubita 1.
keysLine: WASD genda · Shift iruka · Z icaramye · Umwanya simbu · Ibumoso fata vunagura · Iburyo shyira · Q kubita
liteHint: Ni yo yihuta. Ku Chromebook n’iterefone bitinda.
tableHint: Build Table: kurura kugira ngo uzunguruke, kanda ku ruhande ushyire. Utwaro duhindura akerekezo. Enter ishyira.
whatsNewBody: Ingano isa ingano, urugi rufunze rusa rufunze, kandi amakarita y'ubufasha yisobanura.
lbAliasHelp: Hitamo izina ku rutonde. Amazina yanditse ntibikwa.
bbCanvasHelp: Porogaramu zisoma ecran zumva izina ry'akazi, hanyuma intego, gutsinda cyangwa gutsindwa.
hkStepperHelp: Minus na plus bivuga ikintu bahindura.
lbHelp1: Shakisha amanota yawe meza ku mukino.
lbHelp2: Kanda Gutsinda kugira ngo ufungure urwo rutonde.
lbHelp3: Ibyiza byanjye ni ibyawe. Ishuri n'ikigo byerekana 10 ba mbere. Iki cyumweru gitangira ku wa mbere.
lbHelp4: Umwarimu ashobora guhisha tabu cyangwa izina.
testModeHelp: Uburyo bw'igerageza ni ubw'abakozi. Abanyeshuri ntibabubona.
vdHoldHelp: Fata Kwiruka na Gusimbuka kugira ngo ukomeze. Utubuto dukwira kuri buri telefoni.
vdShapeHelp: VEX ni uruziga rufite V. RIO ni kare ifite R. Icyapa kikubwira igihe umuntu asubiye kuri checkpoint.
rfHelpPause: Hagarara byoroshye gukanda buri gihe, ndetse uri ku ruhande.
vdHeldHelp: Fata buto ukomeze. Buto ikanditswe ikayaka kandi yerekana ijambo ryayo.
staffHelpLine: Abakozi: ubufasha bw'urupapuro rw'abakozi ubu bugaragara mu rurimi rwawe.
finePrintKid: Ibintu by'ingenzi ku porogaramu: ninde yazikoze, uko dukurinze, n'uwo uvugana.
rfTestHelp: Abakozi gusa: mu buryo bw'igerageza, iruka gutsinda cyangwa gutsindwa; amanota ajya ku kibaho cya TEST gusa.
vizHelp: Hitamo isura. Kanda Kina. Kanda 🎤 Amataro ya mikoro kugira ngo ishusho idanirane n'icyumba.
helpMicState: Umurongo wa mikoro wererekana niba ikora, yumva, cyangwa yahagaritswe.
